Bhaee duj ke shubh avsar par sabhi bhaee-bahnon ko hardik shubhkamnaen.
Eeshvar se prarthana hai ki bhaee-bahan ka yah pyara sanbandh sadaiv prem, vishvas aur khushiyon se bhara rahe.
bhaee-bahan ka pyar bana rahe! hamesha prem, vishvas aur khushiyon se bhara rahe.
bhaee-bahan ka pyar bana rahe! bhaee duj vishesh | Bhai Dooj Special Jukebox | bhaee-bahan ke pyar bhare git
Bhaee-bahan ke atut prem, sneh aur khubsurat rishte ko samarpit hai bhaee duj ka yah vishesh git sangraha.
